scene chikayumishower1
And so I take you somewhere else without the use of teleportation, just secret narrator powers.
It’s somewhere far detached from the [[mind]set you just stood in, but not so far detached from where you’re meant to be right now according to my outline.
But ignoring my broken tripod and the roaring sounds of water crashing down onto both stone and the reddened flesh of an unpictured girl, the mood here is better. Relaxed.
The sun has begun its descent and, with it, madness too disembarks in preparation for the evening’s promised melancholy.
A door slides open, revealing she who carries such cholera — nude once more thanks to the author’s perversions and their apparently infinite desire to see her exposed breasts.
scene chikayumishower2
And next, the music.
scene chikayumishower3
It isn’t the “normal” song for a situation like this. Especially when she who canonically sings it is currently in the backseat of a limousine right now.
But it helps set the stage. And it’s only one step detached from a song the naked girl in front of us would memorize on early-morning walks to school.
scene chikayumishower4
That tinny, overmodulated sound you only get from old or cheap headphones would do nothing to distract her from the words she’d hear but never heed.

Then sooner rather than later, she’d be plucking them from her ears and fixing her skirt before sitting down beside the girl she just laid her eyes on — the second-most impermanent recipient of all of her “good mornings.”
: Yumi?...
scene chikayumishower5
: Oh, good. Glad it’s you and not somebody else. Saves me an assault charge.
: Since when do you shower before it’s dark out?
: Since when do you shower after the sun starts setting?
scene chikayumishower6
: I figured this was the best time to come here without bumping into anybody else. I take it you’re...in the same boat?
: Pretty much. Never got a chance to take one last night, so I figured I’d get it out of the way now before dinner.
: Should I wait until you’re done then?...
scene chikayumishower5
: Huh?
: Because, like...I don’t know. You don’t really like me anymore and you wanted to be alone. So I’m kind of intruding.
: I can wait. It’s fine.
: Chika, did you somehow manage to forget who cast who aside in the middle of your year-long psychotic break? Cause I sure as fuck ain’t the one who stopping liking you.
: Right. I get that. But, if I were you, I’d probably think I’m pretty fucking selfish and stupid and not want to be naked beside me anymore.
: Weird to say this, but you’ve seen me naked more than literally anybody else I’ve ever known. I really don’t give a shit.
: It’s...okay if join you then?
scene chikayumishower7
: Yeah, sure. It’s fuckin’ creepier with you hanging out in the background like that, so just hurry up and sit down already.
scene black
scene chikayumishower8
: Thank you. For both letting me be naked with you and also not hating me despite you having every right to do that.
: Just glad you seem fuckin’ normal today. Been a while.
: I’m getting there. How’s your mom?
scene chikayumishower9
: Oh. Uhh...she’s alright, I guess.
: Tsubasa’s taking care of her, right?
: That’s one way to put it. Not sure if it’s just cause she’s payin’ for her whole treatment or what, but that lady’s got Yuki on a fuckin’ leash it seems.
: You’re still calling her Yuki even after everything that’s happened?
: Just because she’s dying don’t mean I’m gonna forgive her for choosin’ drugs over me when I was a kid. Think she’ll always just be Yuki to me. Callin’ her “Mom” or whatever just feels weird.
: Fair enough. I’m glad to hear she’s okay, though. Even if I am obligated to hate her as your friend. If...we’re still even-
scene chikayumishower10
: Yes, you sappy piece of shit. We are still friends. Now, stop being weird about it already.
scene chikayumishower11
: Noted...Though, it seems like I have some work to do if I’m going to reclaim my spot as your best friend from Noriko, who has apparently seized it.
: Oh, fuck off. I ain’t gonna rank the two of you. Probably not fair to Noriko if anything since you’re way less annoying than she is when you aren’t trying to kill me.
: Chinami’s been asking about you, you know.
: Why? She texts me all the fuckin’ time about when I’m going to come around again.
scene chikayumishower12
: Oh, right. I wonder why she asks me at all then?
: Some kinda subliminal messaging or some shit, maybe. Trying to get you to reach out to me, I guess.
scene chikayumishower13
: Maybe...
: And I’m sorry I haven’t. I’ve been thinking about you, though. It’s just, like...I kind of needed some time away from...basically everyone in order to get my head on straight again.
: Yeah, you made that pretty apparent during Christmalloween. Guessing that’s why you’re hiding in the showers at like 4:00 PM too? Afraid of bumping into Rin or something?
: Let’s, like...not talk about Rin, if possible. The less I think about her, the better. And I already spent most of our last meeting bitching about my own life, so it’s your turn now.
: You sure about that? Cause I ain’t got much to bitch about and it sounds like you’ve got a ton.
: Alternatively, we could just, like...not bitch about anything at all and just hang out like old times? I’m sure some good stuff has happened to us in the last year or so, right?
scene chikayumishower14
: Uh...y...yeah...
: I guess...not everything has been shitty...
: Oooooh?...Now that’s a rare expression. Do tell...
scene black
: A...Actually, I...I’m done showering and I’m gonna go, like...soak in the hot spring now.
: Oh, wait! I want to come. I’ll be quick.
: A quick shower for you is like thirty fucking minutes, so I’ll just see you when I’m about to get out, I guess.
: No, I can actually be quick this time! There’s gossip involved!
: It’s not even gossip! Just fucking...take your time or whatever!
: Nope! Done now.
: There’s no way that was enough time! You didn’t even wash your hair.
scene chikayumishower15
: Well, duh. Washing your hair every day is actually bad for it. And I’ve definitely told you that before, so don’t pretend this is new information.
: Ain’t bleaching your hair bad for it too? What happened to using your natural color?
: A little thing called mania. I’m sure you’ll experience it one day when your emotions finish developing and you decide to shave your head in a fit of rage or something.
: I hope not. Pretty sure shaved heads don’t normally go well with my, uhh...size.
scene chikayumishower16
: Have they gotten bigger? Because I feel like they’ve gotten bigger.
: A little bit, yeah...Don’t fuckin’ stare at ‘em, though. Unless you’re gonna try and get gay with me next.
: Are you saying it’s okay if I do get gay with you?
: If you don’t mind drowning in a hot spring, yeah.
: So what was that blush before? What are you not telling me?
: Don’t worry about it. Really. I’d prefer to, like...keep this to myself. For probably a hundred different reasons.
: Okay. I’m not gonna pry or anything. But know that you can talk to me if you want to.
: And even if it’s something about you, like, making out with Sensei or something, I’m not going to try to kill you again. I’ve more or less come to terms with his...promiscuity by now.
: I...will keep that in mind.
scene chikayumishower17
: You know...it’s kind of weird. I feel like I always wind up in the bath with people on the days I doubt myself the most. I wonder if the universe is trying to tell me something?
: What? You mean, like...bathe more?
: No, idiot. Something about, like...calming down and remembering my roots. Taking things easy.
: You sure that ain’t just you prescribing some sorta meaning to random shit cause you want to hear it? How the fuck is bathing “returning to your roots?”
: Because this is how I grew up.
: My mom and I always bathed together before she died. And it wasn’t just great for bonding, but it saved money on water too. It’s how we connected. Like a good luck ritual to start every day.
: Ahh, yeah. Guess you and Chinami do that shit too. Can see what you mean now, I guess.
: Maybe it’s some sort of vulnerability thing? Like, completely shedding your armor in front of somebody else makes it easier to come clean and not keep hiding stuff you would be otherwise.
scene chikayumishower18
: Or maybe you’re just gay as fuck and like being naked with other girls.
: My mom and Chinami included?
: You could be into fuckin’ feet for all I know and I’d have no idea. Not really a thing we talk about.
: Hey, I am more than willing to talk about all sorts of sexual stuff with you. You’re the one who has essentially stitched her vagina shut so you’ll never have to worry about it.
: Yet you accused me of sleeping with the man you love behind your back. Seems like a shitty thing to remove my stitches for.
: That was a different Chika. I’m the good one. I exist again.
: How can I be so sure?
scene chikayumishower19
: Well...I guess you can’t, really. Like, I never thought I’d just lose my mind like that. I never thought I’d lose sight of what really matters. And yet I did.
: So I paid the price for it and ruined the second most important relationship in my life.
: You mean you and Sensei?
scene chikayumishower20
: No, you stupid bitch! I mean you!
: Well, is Chinami in fuckin’ third then? Because there ain’t no way I’m more important to you than Sensei is.
scene chikayumishower21
: You are, though. I was just so blinded by my entire life unraveling that I lost sight for a moment.

: Sensei ain’t ever been your “entire life,” Chika. You just told yourself he was because you want to live in a fuckin’ fairy tale where everything is good all the time and that just ain’t ever gonna be true.
: I know that. And this isn’t me trying to avoid responsibility or whatever, but you know why that happened, right? You know why I broke so easily.
scene chikayumishower22
: Course I know. That’s why I don’t hold it against you.
: Always knew you were gonna crack one day. That’s why I’ve always tried to warn you about that guy. It’s always people in positions like yours that get this shit the worst.

: You wrap everything up in one person and put all your faith in them because it makes the burden you’re carryin’ a little less heavy. Then you remember at the end of the day why you were carryin’ shit alone in the first place.
: There’s a reason I let myself get close to you, Chika. And it’s cause we ain’t really all that different at the end of the day. You just...like to pretend we are sometimes.
: Why didn’t you hit me?
scene chikayumishower23
: Heh?
: Like, you could have literally just slapped some sense into me and you didn’t.
: You tryin’ to blame all this shit on me not hitting you now?
: Of course not. Just, you know, maybe actually hit me if I wind up losing myself again. I honestly think it could work.
: Should I hit you right now then?
scene chikayumishower24
: Now? But I thought I was cured. I thought I was good again?
: Social butterflies don’t form cocoons in the middle of parties, dude. You’re out here avoiding confrontation cause you’re scared of what’ll happen out there when you bump into fuckin’ Rin.
: We agreed to not talk about her. Stop it.
: You make a choice yet? Which one of them it’s gonna be? Cause that’s what you’re hung up on, yeah?
scene chikayumishower25
: I chose Sensei.
: Yeah, of fuckin’ course you did.
: I know it’s the wrong choice. And I don’t want this to sound like I’m some sort of martyr or whatever-
: Good, because I deal with enough of that shit from Noriko.
: I just...think it’s what’s better for Rin. And I don’t want to be confusing her when she’s still trying to figure out who she is.
: So you think it’s better for Rin to go fuck some creepy old guy than a girl her age who she’s already had feelings for in the past.
: Obviously not. I just think I shouldn’t be making any choices for her. Especially when most of those choices were driven by my...uhh...irrational obsession with her.
: You implying there’s some kinda obsession that is rational?
: Well, that’s kinda just what love is as a whole, don’t you think?
scene chikayumishower26
: Not really, no.
: Don’t fucking lie to me, whore. I’m not going to forget we’re only in here because you got all embarrassed and stormed off after I asked you if anything good has happened lately.
: Can we not?
: You pressed me about Rin, so it’s only fair I get to press you about this.
: Just ignore it and we can call it even for you almost killing me that one time.
: When did it happen? What happened?
: Chika-
: It’s Sensei, right? For real this time.
scene chikayumishower27
: Hah...
: It was bound to happen eventually, Yumi. I’ve known you like him even longer than you have. And I’m...happy for you. Really.
: No you fuckin’ ain’t, Chika. You’re as loyal as a fucking dog and I...I...kissed your...whatever the fuck he is.
: Do dogs cheat on their owners now? Because I did.
: Yeah, to get back at your fuckin’ owner for spending all of his free time rolling around with other dogs at the local pound. That ain’t your fault.
: It doesn’t matter whose fault anything is. What matters is that it happened. And that it will keep happening because he just...isn’t happy with one dog.
: He won’t be happy with any amount of dogs. He’s a fucking man-whore.

: You’re right. He won’t. That’s why he hangs out somewhere they’re all desperate to be adopted. He can get all their hopes and up...make them envision a perfect little home where they get all the attention they need.
: Where their every need is taken care of and they never have to worry about anything. And all it takes is a few minutes of patting our heads and giving us little treats.
scene chikayumishower28
: Dogs...people...we’re all pretty simple, really. We just want to feel loved and special.
: And it doesn’t really matter how much of a lone wolf you are when you’re a pack animal by instinct, Yumi.
: It’s probably sad watching everyone else at the pound get taken on walks while you sit there in your cage, barking at anyone who walks by.
: They don’t realize you’re just barking because you’re scared, though. They don’t realize that...you’d make a great dog if someone just gave you the chance.
: I’m glad you get to go for a walk now. That you’re getting the chance I got. That everyone got.
scene chikayumishower29
: Not sure how much of a fan I am as referring to a bunch of girls as dogs and some fuckin’ weird guy as the only human in this hypothetical.
: It’s more about our ages and less about our sex. Like, Miss Watabe would be a human too or something. It isn’t only Sensei.
: You really aren’t mad at me? Because I’ve felt like shit about this, I’m not gonna lie.
: You and Noriko are both wrapped the fuck up in him and I’m just over here, like...not hating him as much as I used to. What gives me the right to do what you guys do?
: Since when do you care about your “rights?”
scene chikayumishower30
: Yo. The fuck are you doing?
: My Yumi never concerns herself with what she is or isn’t allowed to do. She does things anyway. Regardless of the consequences they could bring.
: Cool, yeah. You gotta rub your boobs against me to tell me that, though?
scene chikayumishower31
: Yes, actually. As a matter of fact, I do.
: Well, stop. You know this shit makes me feel weird.
: If you feel weird about your best or ex best friend pressing her boobs against you, how the hell are you going to feel when Sensei has his naked body pressed against yours?
scene chikayumishower32
: Chill, dude! It was just a fuckin’ kiss!

: Yeah, for now. But then it’ll be fingering. And handjobs. And before you know it, the two of you are going to be tangled up in the sheets of his bed. Or your bed. Whoever’s bed, really. Probably both.
: I...already told him I don’t wanna do that shit! I want to, like...go slow and...everything.

: Yeah, good luck with that. And not just because he’s Sensei either. It’s because hormones are evil and being alone together with the person you like will do things to you. Bad things. And you will give in to them.
: On second thought, I think I preferred it when you did hate me for potentially doing shit with him! That was way better than this!
scene chikayumishower33
: I love you so much, Yumi. I missed you so much.
: Stop growing up without me. We’re supposed to do that together.
: Well, was I supposed to just...fuckin’ wait all this time? The hell do you want from me?
: Just you in general. It’s nothing specific.
: Okay, then sure. Let’s be fuckin’ friends again or whatever. I don’t know how to cook and you do so I’m already benefiting from this.
scene chikayumishower34
: Good! Now, tell me more about your kiss. How’d it happen? Where did it happen? Who initiated it?
: Think I liked you better when you were strictly into monogamy.
scene chikayumishower35
: Oh my god! This means I can finally teach you how to suck a dick now! I’ve waited forever for this!
: Why?!?! No!!
scene noonsky
And so the chapter closes on a friendship once fragmented as two parties pick up the pieces.
Each one assembles a half of a heart and presses them together, reluctantly as it may be, to form a key that opens a door to a brand new coloring book.
Upon realizing they only have one crayon, however, they will need to learn to share if they want to work on completing said book and opening the next door.
Breaking the crayon in half is impossible, you see. The crayon has bones and will bleed all over the place.
But the bright side is that it changes colors every thirteen minutes and vibrates gently between thumb and forefinger.
All of this means nothing, of course. This passage is but a coloring book as well. One sold on shelves all over the country. And so its guts will always be different, but its cover never changes.
Books like this do not have chapters. But you can certainly draw them in.
